query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM editorial.review_decisions WHERE review_snapshot_id=$1 AND decision='APPROVE' AND reviewer_id<>$2) AND (NOT $3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM editorial.review_decisions d JOIN ops.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id=d.reviewer_id AND ur.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN ops.roles r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.code='LEGAL_REVIEWER' WHERE d.review_snapshot_id=$1 AND d.decision='APPROVE'))
